definitions.explanation: The unit of reproduction in plants.
The origin or cause of something.
Subject matter for discussion or creation.

examples.japanese: ⟦ひまわり→向日葵：04999_himawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

examples.english: I sowed vegetable seeds in the garden.
To become a source of worry.
It became a source of laughter.

notes:
{種|たね} has both literal (seed) and figurative (source/topic) meanings.

LITERAL USES (seeds):
- {種|たね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒔|ま}く→蒔く：02419_maku⟧: to sow seeds
- {種|たね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to save/harvest seeds
- ⟦ひまわり→向日葵：04999_himawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}: sunflower seeds
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}: flower seeds

FIGURATIVE USES (source/cause):
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}: topic of conversation
- ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}: source of laughter
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}: cause of worry
- ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}: source of trouble
- ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種|たね}: news material

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{種|たね}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕掛|しか}け→仕掛け：07916_shikake⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no tricks (literally 'no seeds or mechanisms' - used by magicians)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧: seedling (plant that has sprouted)
- ⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧: fruit, seed (of fruit)
